skills.name: LCD Conversion
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator for two fractions with different denominators and convert both to equivalent fractions over that denominator.

skills.name: Common-Denominator Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions or fractional parts that already share the same denominator to obtain the fraction-part result.

skills.name: Whole-Number Part Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers (or of a whole number and a mixed number/fraction) separately from the fractional parts.

skills.name: Borrowing for Negative Fraction Result
skills.definition: When subtracting the fractional parts yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as denominator/denominator) from the whole part and add it to the minuend's fraction before subtracting again.

skills.name: Simplify to Lowest Terms
skills.definition: Reduce a resulting fraction to its simplest equivalent form by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Improper Mixed-Number Regrouping
skills.definition: Recognize a mixed number whose fractional part's numerator is greater than or equal to its denominator and convert/regroup it into standard mixed-number form before completing the subtraction.
